notes: 每条 quote 为来源页面原句(英文/德文/中文保持原文),用于后续事实核查/反驳/合规三方审查。
relation 取值:nectar | pollen | pollination | observed-visit | none;'none' 表示在所查来源中未找到该蜂对该花的明确记载,并非否定存在。

english_name.value: highbush blueberry(northern highbush blueberry);别名 swamp blueberry、American blueberry 等
english_name.quote: Vaccinium corymbosum, the northern highbush blueberry, is a North American species of blueberry which has become a food crop of significant economic importance. ... Alternate Names: Northern highbush blueberry, southeastern highbush blueberry, Maryland highbush blueberry, black highbush blueberry, American blueberry, New Jersey blueberry, rabbiteye blueberry, swamp blueberry, tall huckleberry, mayberry, whortleberry
english_name.note: 维基百科英文条目首句给出 northern highbush blueberry;USDA NRCS Plant Guide 列出 Alternate Names。

chinese_name.value: 高丛蓝莓(北高丛蓝莓);通称蓝莓、越橘
chinese_name.quote: 越橘、高丛蓝莓、北高丛蓝莓(中文维基“藍莓”条目名称/别名);栽培蓝莓主要来源于 Vaccinium corymbosum
chinese_name.note: 中文维基无独立“高丛蓝莓”条目(404),名称取自“藍莓”条目;“高丛越橘”亦见于部分中文资料,未在此核验。

the flower is radially symmetrical ... the perianth parts are fused to form a tube, cup, or bell shape ... the inflorescence is a raceme (a long unbranched stem with stalked flowers growing along it)
Die Krone ist 6 bis 12 mm lang, mit fünf weißen oder hell rosa, zylindrisch oder nah dem Schlund sich schwach verjüngenden Zipfeln.
其花为总状花序,大多数都是侧生,极少的是顶生,每条花序有7-10朵花,颜色为白色或粉红色。

petal_count.quote: Flowers 8-10 in a cluster, 6-12 mm long, urn-shaped, white, with 5 petals.

nectar_pollen.value: 有花蜜(蜜腺位于花萼基部);可产单花种蜂蜜“蓝莓蜜”;蜜蜂和野生蜂访花采集花蜜与花粉;花粉藏于孔裂花药(poricidal anthers),需振动释放;木蜂/蜜蜂会在花侧咬孔盗蜜
nectar_pollen.quote: Blueberry honey is taken from the tiny white flowers of the blueberry bush. It has a pleasant full, well-rounded flavor, a slight tang, and a blueberry aftertaste.

supporting_quotes.quote: Am Grund des Kelches liegen die Nektar produzierenden Nektarien.
More than 80 bee species visit Michigan blueberry flowers to collect pollen and nectar to feed their young.

Carpenter bees often cut a slit in the side of blueberry flowers in order to access the nectar, allowing honey bees to do the same in later visits. Nectar robbing bees still transfer some pollen between flowers, meaning that this practice can contribute to rather than take away from total pollination; however, when nectar robbing by honey bees begins to approach half of all honey bee visits, blueberry seed and fruit set are reduced.
This plant provides nectar for pollinators.

nectar_pollen.note: 未找到权威来源给出单花泌蜜量或花粉量的数值。

buzz_pollination.value: 蓝莓属于振动授粉(buzz pollination)植物:花药孔裂,花粉需由熊蜂等振动释放;蜜蜂不能振动授粉;熊蜂、木蜂、地蜂、部分壁蜂等可以
buzz_pollination.quote: Some members of the genus Vaccinium [are pollinated by buzz pollination] - Blueberries ... Honeybees cannot perform buzz pollination.

supporting_quotes.quote: The anthers are completely sealed except for a small pore at the top or have very small slits that open along the sides...they are often referred to as poricidal anthers.

The structure of blueberry anthers is such that pollen is most effectively released by active vibration of flowers ... buzz-pollination, the behavior of vibrating flowers to release pollen, is performed by a host of wild bee species, but not by honey bees

Blueberry flowers are bell-shaped and the pollen is most efficiently dispensed from the flowers' anthers through a process called sonication, or 'buzz' pollination. ... Honey Bees are not capable of buzz pollination ... Several families of native bees are, including bumble bees, large carpenter bees, mining (Andrenid) bees, many sweat bees, some mason (Osmia) bees and Melitta bees.
predominant floral trait related to buzzing behavior is the presence of poricidal anthers ... only exit of pollen from the flower is via tiny openings at the apex of the anthers

pollinator_dependence.value: 高度依赖蜂类传粉。维基:四倍体、不自花授粉;USDA:自交可育但异花授粉显著提高坐果与果实大小;MSU:多数北高丛品种可用自身花粉授粉但仍需蜂传粉才能形成大而可售的果;PFAF:非自交可育、至少部分自交不亲和
pollinator_dependence.quote: The species is tetraploid and does not self-pollinate.

supporting_quotes.quote: Highbush blueberry (V. corymbosum) is self-fertile, but cross-pollination increases fruit set and results in larger, earlier berries with more seeds ... Bees are the primary pollinator.

Highbush blueberries need pollination in order to produce large, marketable fruit. Pollination increases fruit set, berry size, and allows for earlier ripening. Most common cultivars of northern highbush can be well pollinated by their own pollen and are planted in large blocks. Others benefit greatly from cross-pollination and should be interplanted.
Highbush blueberry yields are dependent on pollination by bees
High-quality fruit production by wild and commercial blueberries is highly dependent on the input of biotic pollinators
The plant is not self-fertile ... Plants are at least partially self-sterile, more than one variety is required in order to obtain good yields of fruit

pollinator_dependence.note: 来源间关于“自交可育性”表述不一致(维基“不自花授粉”vs USDA/MSU“自交可育但异花授粉更好”),撰写卡片时应用“需要蜂类传粉,异花授粉显著提升产量”这一各方一致的表述,避免绝对化。

visitors.detail: 商业传粉主力(美国密歇根 2–4 箱/英亩);采集花蜜与花粉,产蓝莓蜜;不能振动授粉,单次访花效率低于熊蜂,需约 3 次访花;会跟随木蜂咬孔盗蜜
visitors.quote: Honey Bees (Apis mellifera) are commonly managed or rented for blueberry pollination. Honey bees are easy to manage and transport, and provide many active pollinators per hive. A 6–8 frame colony will have around 15,000–20,000 pollinating bees. Hives are typically placed at a rate of 2–4 hives/acre when the crop reaches 5–10% bloom, and are removed from fields at petal fall.

supporting_quotes.quote: introduction of managed honey bees is the primary strategy used for pollination of this crop
hives of the honey bee (Apis mellifera) are widely managed for blueberry pollination throughout the world
Honeybees cannot perform buzz pollination.
Blueberry honey is taken from the tiny white flowers of the blueberry bush.

visitors.detail: 中国温室北高丛蓝莓‘Bluecrop’试验中作为传粉者之一,效率介于欧洲熊蜂与西方蜜蜂之间(单次访花柱头落粉量为熊蜂的一半,高于西方蜜蜂)
visitors.quote: Here, we compared the performance in visiting frequency and pollination efficiency among three bee pollinators (Bombus terrestris, Apis cerana, and Apis mellifera) on greenhouse-grown northern highbush 'Bluecrop' blueberry plants and evaluate their effects on yield and fruit quality. ... pollen deposition on the stigma from single visit by B. terrestris was twice and three times that of A. cerana and A. mellifera, respectively. The yield of individual plants pollinated by B. terrestris showed an increase of 11.4% and 20.0% compared with the plants pollinated by A. cerana and A. mellifera, respectively
visitors.note: Sun et al. 2021, HortScience 56(5):603–607。摘要文本经 Semantic Scholar API 获取(https://api.semanticscholar.org/graph/v1/paper/DOI:10.21273/hortsci15714-21?fields=title,abstract);出版社页面对抓取返回 403,人工可访问。

visitors.detail: 商业传粉者:智利等地大量进口欧洲熊蜂群为蓝莓传粉;能振动授粉、在不利天气下活动;中国温室试验中传粉效率最高;但在原生区外具入侵风险
visitors.quote: Managed beehives of B. terrestris achieve high yields due, partially, to their ability to sonicate flowers ... introduction of B. terrestris generates serious problems for the conservation of native pollinators

supporting_quotes.quote: The highly efficient pollination of B. terrestris was attributed to its behavior of buzz-pollination. Therefore, it is preferential for pollination of 'Bluecrop' blueberry in the greenhouse.
Bombus terrestris [listed as an example of a buzz-pollinating bee species]
Landscape effects on wild Bombus terrestris (Hymenoptera: Apidae) queens visiting highbush blueberry fields in south-central Chile
supporting_quotes.note: 仅核验到论文标题(Apidologie 2015),摘要未能抓取。

supporting_quotes.quote: Bumble Bees (Bombus spp.) are highly efficient blueberry pollinators. ... Because of their large body size, bumble bees can fly at lower temperatures than honey bees, making them ideal pollinators in typical early spring weather. Commercial colonies can be as effective as honey bees if enough are used

visitors.detail: 新西兰白车轴草种子田调查:欧洲熊蜂访花并在小花间移动更快,单位效率高于西方蜜蜂,但因数量少总体贡献较低;可在蜜蜂不利天气下觅食形成互补
visitors.quote: B. terrestris were considered a more efficient pollinator than A. mellifera moving faster between florets but were less effective due to low abundances. Many Bombus spp. will forage under weather conditions unfavourable to A. mellifera, therefore, providing complimentary pollination.

supporting_quotes.quote: The flowers are mostly visited by bumblebees and often by honey bees.
Clovers are most efficiently pollinated by bumblebees, which have declined as a result of agricultural intensification.
